proposition: Melvin-Koushki's Prologue characterises Ibn Turka as refusing to bend the knee during his three inquisitions, despite the danger and punishing consequences. No source is cited for the characterisation on that page.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka's conduct at his inquisitions

mediation.note: offered as a rhetorical parallel to the lack of self-deprecation in the Mafāḥiṣ prologue; no citation
